system.story: Lay hands on steel and code - the only healing in the game that works on machines and Cyborgs.

target.custom: One ally, machine, drone, or Cyborg

effect.after:
Main action (or maneuver for a quick patch), touch or Wired range, no Resonance cost. Channel Resonance to restore Integrity/Stamina equal to your Recovery value (7) to a machine, drone, vehicle, piece of chrome, or a Cyborg, or clear a mechanical/Wired condition (glitch, jam, suppression). The class's signature niche - the only healing in the game that works on Cyborgs and tech. On Outcome Tier 1, mend more and clear a condition; on Tier 3 the patch is unstable (holds until next hit).

Enhance - Spend Resonance: mend at greater range or a second target, or restore a wrecked machine / crashing Cyborg to minimal function.
